description: Carl and Nancy are a horrifying fusion of two entities, constantly shifting between male and female forms, bound together by a single consciousness. Their appearance is grotesque—Carl's half is a towering figure made of twisted flesh and bone, with countless eyes peering out from his muscular form. Nancy's half is a shadowy figure with long, ethereal limbs that seem to phase in and out of reality, with her face obscured by a veil of black mist. Together, they have the power to reshape galaxies, their voices creating harmonies that can bend the fabric of space and time.
image: A grotesque fusion of two beings, one muscular with multiple eyes, the other shadowy and ethereal.
lair_type: Carl and Nancy dwell within a nexus of interdimensional space, where time warps and the rules of reality are bent.

traits.name: Dual Minds
traits.description: Carl and Nancy have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws. They can also take an additional action on their turn once per round.

traits.name: Reality Warp
traits.description: Once per day, Carl and Nancy can alter the fabric of reality within 1,000 feet, causing time to slow or reverse, or altering the terrain completely.

actions.name: Cosmic Shriek
actions.description: Carl and Nancy release a harrowing shriek, sending out psychic waves in a 500-foot radius. All creatures in the area must make a DC 28 Wisdom saving throw or take 110 (15d10) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute.

actions.name: Dimensional Tear
actions.description: They can open a rift in the fabric of space, transporting themselves and others to a different plane of existence. The rift remains open for 1 minute.

lair_actions.name: Tidal Shift
lair_actions.description: Carl and Nancy can reverse gravity within their lair, causing all creatures to be pulled into the sky and take 70 (10d12) force damage when they fall.

regional_effects.name: Dimensional Flux
regional_effects.description: Within 5 miles of Carl and Nancy’s lair, space bends and warps, creating spatial distortions and temporal anomalies.
